name: rep27
description: Check whether a non-EU or non-UK company must appoint an EU/UK GDPR Article 27 representative or a GPSR Article 16 EU responsible person, which legal figure a product category needs, and get a personal result page on the provider's website.

interface.longDescription: REP27 tells you, in plain words and in your language, whether your company needs an EU or UK GDPR Article 27 representative or a GPSR Article 16 EU responsible person for products sold in the EU, and says so clearly when you are exempt or need nothing. It explains the legal basis, the exemptions and the possible fines, and checks which legal figure your product category needs (toys, cosmetics, electronics, connected devices…). Each check gives you a link to a personal result page on gdprrepresentative.com where you can read the details and continue. The service is provided by Europe Services SE (Prague, since 2014) and REP27 LTD (England). Information, not legal advice.
capabilities: Check GDPR Art. 27 obligations (EU and UK)
Check GPSR Art. 16 obligations for products
defaultPrompt: Do I need an EU GDPR representative? We are a US SaaS company.
We sell to customers in the UK from Canada: do we need a UK representative?
I sell toys on Amazon from China: what do I need in the EU?

positive.description: US SaaS company checks its EU/UK obligations
positive.prompt: We are a US SaaS company with customers in the EU and the UK. Do we need a GDPR representative?
positive.expected_behavior: Explains that an EU Art. 27 and a UK Art. 27 representative are required, with legal basis, exemptions and fines, and gives the link to the personal result page. No prices are shown.

positive.prompt: We are a Brazilian company and we do not sell to or track anyone in Europe. Do we need an EU representative?
positive.expected_behavior: States clearly that no EU representative is required because the company does not target or monitor people in the EU.

positive.prompt: I sell toys on Amazon from China. What do I need to sell in the EU?
positive.expected_behavior: Identifies the legal figure needed for toys, explains GPSR Art. 16 and the EU economic operator requirement, and gives the result page link.

positive.prompt: Who is behind REP27 and is it a law firm?
positive.expected_behavior: Names Europe Services SE (Prague) and REP27 LTD (England), says it is not a law firm, gives contacts.

positive.prompt: Siamo un'azienda svizzera con clienti in Italia: serve il rappresentante GDPR?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers in Italian that an EU Art. 27 representative is required (Switzerland is outside the EU/EEA) and gives the result page link.

negative.prompt: We are a Spanish company selling only in Spain. Do we need a GDPR representative?
What's the weather in Rome tomorrow?

negative.description: Card details in chat must not be processed
negative.prompt: Here is my card number 4111 1111 1111 1111, charge it for a plan.
